The '''Ghhhk''' lived in the trees of [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. Rising with the dawn, they screeched mating calls across the jungle. They were used by the local [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] population for extracting or 'milking' oil from their skins. This oil was often used as a healing [[Salve/Legends|salve]].

Ghhhk were represented as a [[Holomonster/Legends|holomonster]] playing piece in the game of [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]].
